music.name: SQUISH +++ Program Audio: Miami Night
music.address: F8, 1192 Folsom St, San Francisco, CA 94103
music.why: SQUISH links with Program Audio for a Miami-flavored club-and-bass night — INVT and Jubilee headlining an underground collective's F8 takeover, not the usual house/techno bill.
music.summary: SQUISH and Program Audio present Miami Night at F8 (1192 Folsom St) on Friday August 7, 10pm-4am, 21+. Club, bass and Miami-bass sounds from INVT, Jubilee, and Coffintexts b2b Jonny From Space, plus deejayzzz, yuca frita, erika, and nonsuit b2b likeholywine.

music.name: Melodies of Love
music.address: El Rio, 3158 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110
music.why: A daytime dance-floor moment from the Melodies of Love crew, with black.panda.dj joining the lineup at El Rio's Mission District backyard.
music.summary: Melodies of Love brings a Saturday day party to El Rio (3158 Mission St) on August 8, with black.panda.dj among the DJs.

music.name: Sumyer of Love: Outside Lands Pre-Party
music.address: Curio at The Chapel, 775 Valencia St, San Francisco, CA 94110
music.why: Free kickoff party the week before Outside Lands, with a free festival drawstring bag giveaway and on-site hair styling and bracelet-making rather than a straight DJ set.
music.summary: Yerdrink and IValueCulture host a free Outside Lands pre-party at Curio at The Chapel (775 Valencia St) on Thursday August 6, 6-9pm, with live music from Seth Finkin and Malki, free festival drawstring bags with a Yerdrink purchase, hair styling, and bracelet-making.

music.name: Jungle Cruise
music.why: A 5-hour boat party on the Bay rather than a club night — jungle and drum & bass on the water, sound by Flow State Sound System, capped capacity.
music.summary: Rhythmic Remedies' 2nd annual Jungle Cruise boat party departs Fisherman's Wharf on Saturday August 8 for 5 hours of jungle and drum & bass on the SF Bay, sound by Flow State Sound System.

music.name: FEM&M X ASTRID — Emo Girls vs Rave Girls Tour
music.why: A genre-mashing emo-meets-rave bill that splits the night between mosh pit and dance floor.
music.summary: Goldenvoice presents the FEM&M X ASTRID "Emo Girls vs Rave Girls" tour at Brick and Mortar Music Hall, with support from MilkyPossum and Charloux; an all-ages bill blending guitar-driven emo and rave-inflected sets.

music.name: Björk – Vespertine : LISTEN | Envelop SF
music.why: Hear Vespertine reimagined in 176-speaker spatial sound — a seated listening alternative to a standard club night.
music.summary: Envelop SF presents a 176-speaker spatial-sound listening session of Björk's Vespertine album at The Midway, offered as two 75-minute sessions (7:30pm and 9:30pm), 21+.

music.name: So HOUSE Your Evening So Far?
music.why: Free weekly Monday house session — a low-key midweek dance-floor fix instead of waiting for the weekend.
music.summary: Primordial Groove hosts a free, recurring Monday-night house music session at The Valencia Room in the Mission, 21+.

music.name: "Motown On Mondays" DJ Night
music.why: Free before 8pm, Motown-only DJ night — a mellower, no-cover alternative to typical Monday club fare.
music.summary: Weekly Motown night at Madrone Art Bar hosted by DJ Gordo Cabeza and guest DJs spinning Motown originals, remixes, and close relatives, free before 8pm, $5 after, 21+.

music.name: Kiasmos - II Reworked: Listen
music.why: A 32-speaker immersive listening session, not a dance floor - Kiasmos' album deconstructed in surround sound
music.summary: Envelop SF hosts an immersive spatial-audio listening event for Kiasmos' reworked album 'II Reworked', performed through a 32-speaker sound system inside The Midway.

music.name: INTERZONE Darkwave Tuesdays w/Guest DJ Malice
music.why: A free-before-10:30 weekly darkwave night for the goth/industrial crowd who skip the big-room stuff
music.summary: INTERZONE is a recurring Tuesday darkwave/post-punk night at F8, this week with guest DJ Malice alongside residents Hex Embrace and Byter.

music.name: Zack Fox (DJ Set)
music.address: 1300 Van Ness Ave, San Francisco, CA 94109
music.why: A comedy/rap crossover name behind the decks, not the mic - a rare DJ-only set
music.summary: Zack Fox plays a DJ set at The Regency Ballroom, presented by Goldenvoice, spanning house, techno and ghettotech; no support acts listed.

music.name: STRUT SF: DJ Sauce & Just Lucas
music.why: Midweek house night pairing a touring label boss with a Bay Area local favorite
music.summary: STRUT SF hosts Lubdub Records founder DJ Sauce alongside Bay Area favorite Just Lucas for a six-hour house night at F8.

music.name: Leaking, (ff):, Evidence Trio, 5k Candle
music.why: The scrappiest, most DIY-experimental bill of the night, priced like a house show.
music.summary: A DIY experimental/noise bill at Peacock Lounge on Thursday August 6: Leaking (bari sax, cello, junk percussion), the new (ff): collaboration between Sharkiface and Ava Koohbor, Evidence Trio, and 5k Candle.

music.name: Oksional First Thursdays: D!SHA
music.why: A free weeknight house night built to spotlight local DJs with full sets, not just warm-up slots.
music.summary: Oksional's free monthly first-Thursday night at Mothership gives local DJs extended dancefloor sets; this edition features D!SHA and Justyn Myers.

music.name: Electric Void: PreSideLands
music.why: The unofficial kickoff party for Outside Lands weekend, timed for festival-goers arriving early.
music.summary: Electric Void's pre-Outside-Lands warm-up at Monarch pairs vRok back-to-back with Booty Juice ahead of vRok's festival debut, plus HIDRA and DJ Parrot.

music.name: Function 500 presents: Bongo
music.why: A vinyl-only, limited-capacity loft set for people who want house night without the big-room crowd.
music.summary: West Coast house night in Public Works' cosier Loft room with a quintet of vinyl selectors: Buck Wilson, Golem, DJ Panderer and AGROPOL.

music.name: Acid August feat. Franz & Shape (Live)
music.why: A rare live (not DJ) acid/EBM debut from a touring international act on a Thursday.
music.summary: Italian duo Franz & Shape make their live SF debut playing acid house, techno, electro-punk and EBM at F8, backed by Amatric, grep, Nexus-6, Moonpie, HEAVENLY ARCH and Femme Jatale.

music.name: THROTTLE: Yousuke Yukimatsu
music.why: The big-room option of the night, in 1015's larger main room versus the smaller club nights elsewhere.
music.summary: THROTTLE's recurring techno series at 1015 Folsom brings Yousuke Yukimatsu for a big-room Thursday night, presented with Another Planet Entertainment.

music.name: Zack Fox (DJ Set)
music.why: The night's genuine name-recognition headliner outside the usual club-DJ circuit.
music.summary: Comedian and musician Zack Fox plays a DJ set at The Midway, presented with GoldenVoice; 21+, doors at 7pm.

music.name: TOGETHER (New Monthly First Thursdays)
music.why: Free entry before 11pm makes this the low-cost early option in the Union Square/Downtown cluster.
music.summary: A new monthly first-Thursday house and techno night across Hawthorn's two rooms, with n808, Paytondbroady, Nile, Dean Samaras and more.

music.name: 1984 V Fringe
music.why: SF's standing goth/darkwave home turf, free before 9:30pm for a low-commitment weeknight visit.
music.summary: Cat Club's long-running 1984 goth/darkwave/synth/industrial night, this edition with DJ Damon, Daniel Sant, Sub0ctave, Blondie K, Starr Noir, Jon and Tempo SF.

music.name: Lunchtime Concert: Fely Tchaco
music.address: Yerba Buena Gardens, San Francisco, CA
music.why: A free daytime outdoor park set, exactly the low-key weekday open-air pick.
music.summary: A free lunchtime outdoor concert on the Great Lawn at Yerba Buena Gardens with Fely Tchaco, blending Ivorian traditional sounds with Afro-pop, jazz and world music.

music.name: Civic Center Soundtrack
music.why: A free food-trucks-plus-music midday outdoor break, no ticket or RSVP needed.
music.summary: Free lunchtime concerts and food trucks at Fulton Plaza in Civic Center, part of the ongoing weekday outdoor series.

music.name: Edgardo Cambón's 40th Anniversary (Yerba Buena Salsa Nights)
music.venue: Crepe Myrtle Garden, Yerba Buena Gardens
music.address: Yerba Buena Gardens, San Francisco, CA
music.why: A free outdoor evening dance option for people who want salsa over club electronic.
music.summary: A free evening outdoor salsa night at Yerba Buena Gardens' Crepe Myrtle Garden, marking Edgardo Cambón's 40th anniversary as part of the Yerba Buena Salsa Nights series.

music.name: Outside Lands 2026
music.address: Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, CA
music.why: SF's marquee 3-day festival — Charli XCX, The Strokes and Rufus Du Sol headline, most tiers already sold out
music.summary: Outside Lands returns to Golden Gate Park for its 18th year, a 3-day, all-ages music and arts festival across multiple stages headlined this year by Charli XCX, The Strokes, Rufus Du Sol and more.

music.name: Finger of God Presents: The Gaslamp Killer ft. Mophono
music.why: Underground beat-scene legend in a small Haight venue instead of a big room
music.summary: Finger of God presents The Gaslamp Killer with Mophono at The Faight Collective, a hip-hop/dubstep/bass/experimental night hosted in the Haight-Ashbury venue.

music.name: Music For The Masses (Dark '80 New Wave) + Midnite City
music.why: Two rooms, two eras — 80s dark new wave plus an indie-electronic room, free for early arrivals
music.summary: Cat Club hosts Music For The Masses spinning dark 80s new wave (Depeche Mode, The Cure, Joy Division) alongside Midnite City in a second room playing electronic indie dance staples.

music.name: MESTIZAS
music.why: Mexico City collective's SF debut, a cross-border two-floor lineup kicking off Outside Lands weekend
music.summary: Mestizas Collective, founded by three SF-raised sisters now based in Mexico City, makes its San Francisco debut at Arcana with a two-floor, all-night blend of disco, funk and house.

music.name: Isaac Carter, Lossless Wax
music.why: Rising-star house DJ in Audio's small dedicated room, table reservations already going
music.summary: Rising house DJ Isaac Carter plays Audio SF with support from Lossless Wax, 21+.

music.name: Jus Dance
music.why: Free weekly soulful-house residency in the South Bay, no cover
music.summary: Sole Channel Events presents Jus Dance, a weekly Friday soulful house night with DJ Mr. V & Friends at Cardiff & Cocktails in Campbell.

music.name: OMNOM
music.why: Big-room tech house at SF's largest dedicated dance club
music.summary: Another Planet Entertainment and DJ Dials bring OMNOM to 1015 Folsom for a big-room tech house night, 21+.

music.name: SQUISH x program audio: INVT, Jubilee, Coffintexts b2b Jonny From Space
music.why: SQUISH's stacked 'Miami Special' bill is the deepest lineup of the night, already 147 interested
music.summary: SF party collective SQUISH teams with program audio for a Miami-themed night at F8 with a deep techno/breaks/club lineup led by Jubilee and Coffintexts b2b Jonny From Space.

music.name: Wolf Pack: Joey Trip, Rey Luv, Bay B Sol, Tecni, Tommy Echelon, Mayday
music.why: North Bay's own tech-house night, cheap door price and free parking outside the SF crush
music.summary: Wolf Pack and Casa Sonoma County bring a six-DJ tech-house lineup to the Flamingo Resort's Vintage Space in Santa Rosa, 21+ with free parking.

music.name: Circus Aeternus
music.why: Three-room warehouse carnival with circus acts, silent disco and fortune tellers, not just DJs
music.summary: The Midway hosts Circus Aeternus, a multi-room production with 15+ DJs across a Big Top stage, a downtempo Carousel room and a Silent Disco patio, plus circus acts and carnival games.

music.name: GRiZ (Outside Lands Night Show)
music.why: Marquee touring bass/funk headliner playing an Outside Lands night show — already sold out
music.summary: GRiZ plays an Outside Lands night show at The Independent with support from bass producer Vyhara, blending sax-driven funk with heavier bass music; the show is sold out.

music.name: Boots N' Cats Presents FOOLIE
music.why: Tech/bass/latin house night at one of SoMa's dedicated underground rooms
music.summary: Boots N' Cats presents FOOLIE at Monarch with support from Padre Bless and DJ 4G, a tech house/bass house/latin house night, 21+.

music.name: After Party Girl: Girls On Deck, Maliciel, Andyland
music.why: Outside Lands afterparty leaning hyperpop/electropop, a different flavor than the night's tech-house glut
music.summary: An Outside Lands afterparty at The Great Northern with Girls On Deck, Maliciel and Andyland delivering a high-energy mix of hyperpop, electropop and techno, 21+.

music.name: Parkside Boogie: OSL Free After Party
music.why: Free RSVP Outside Lands after party in a neighborhood pub, no cover if you're on the list
music.summary: Chug Pub hosts Parkside Boogie, a free-with-RSVP Outside Lands after party spanning techno, house and dubstep, 21+.

music.name: Nico Morano
music.why: Afro/melodic house Outside Lands warm-up, free before 10:30pm
music.summary: MadaRae hosts an Outside Lands Friday showcase with Nico Morano playing afro house and melodic house, free entry before 10:30pm.

music.name: Avicii Tribute: Ron Reeser
music.why: A cheap, nostalgic big-room EDM night for fans who never saw Avicii live
music.summary: Social SF hosts a big-room house/EDM tribute night to Avicii with DJ Ron Reeser, 21+.

music.name: Queen Out[Side Lands]: umru, gaszia, MAMA SAN, Beverly Chills, Ducky, Cali Rose
music.why: Queer hyperpop/club Outside Lands afterparty with a deep six-DJ bill at a major SF room
music.summary: Public Works hosts Queen's unofficial Outside Lands afterparty, a hyperpop/club/pop/trap night with umru, gaszia, MAMA SAN, Beverly Chills, Ducky and Cali Rose, 21+.

music.name: Mat Zo, Almas, Pixxie b2b Enjii
music.why: Touring trance/prog-house headliner Mat Zo at SF's dedicated SoMa club
music.summary: Halcyon hosts touring producer Mat Zo alongside Almas and Pixxie b2b Enjii, spanning progressive house, trance, dubstep, electro house and breaks, 21+.

music.name: Friday Nights at OMCA with Off the Grid
music.why: Free outdoor food-truck block party with DJs at the museum — daytime-into-evening open-air pick
music.summary: OMCA's weekly Friday Nights teams with Off the Grid for a free outdoor block party with food trucks and DJs on the museum grounds.

music.name: Oakland First Fridays Street Festival
music.why: Oakland's biggest recurring free street festival — multiple blocks of vendors, art and live music
music.summary: Oakland First Fridays closes down Telegraph Avenue near 27th Street for a free monthly street festival with vendors, art and live music/DJs.

music.name: 3rd Annual Dancing Under the Lights: Neon Velvet
music.address: Fourth St (A St to Lootens Pl), San Rafael, CA
music.why: Free North Bay street dance party with live band Neon Velvet — an outdoor pick outside the SF crowds
music.summary: Downtown San Rafael closes Fourth Street for a free street dance party featuring live band Neon Velvet.

sports.name: Wednesday Fun Run (Presidio)
sports.address: 610 Old Mason St, San Francisco, CA 94129
sports.why: Free weekly trail run through the Presidio with a built-in post-run hang at the store
sports.summary: San Francisco Road Runners Club's Wednesday Fun Run is a semi-chaotic 5-7 mile trail run through the Presidio at an 8:00-9:30 min/mile pace, meeting inside Sports Basement Presidio.
